snippet.title: Super SpongeBob 2 - DLC Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🧽 How would you fair in a battle against yourself if it ever came to that?  🧽

The Super SpongeBob 2 - 1.4.0 DLC update is finally here!

Get ready as this major update includes 3 brand new stages, 2 new boss fights, and a ton of fixes and small reworks to the already existing content.
These stages will be a test for your platforming skill as each one offers brand new stage gimmicks not seen in the base game.

🧽 Be There AND Be Square! 🧽


(I do not own SpongeBob SquarePants nor claim to own the IP. SpongeBob SquarePants is owned by Stephen Hillenburg and Nickelodeon. This project will always be free.)

Get the game here:

Itch.io page: https://lood-man.itch.io/super-spongebob-2
GameJolt page: https://gamejolt.com/games/SuperSpongeBob2/814964

And be sure to take a listen to the game's OST: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyDIbayeBL9Be-2QBb4SdnVlQIWMRAKbf
